description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag called ShopProductRelationshipTag, which retrieves and displays related products based on a specified group name, using services like ProductRelationshipService and PricingService, and cache utilities to optimize performance.

classes.name: ShopProductRelationshipTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that fetches related products based on a group and incorporates caching for performance optimization. It extends RequestContextAwareTag for integration with JSP pages.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Getter method for the group name used to fetch related products.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Setter method to assign the group name for product relationships.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Main logic executed when the tag starts, including autowiring dependencies if needed, retrieving cache, and fetching or setting product relationships in request attributes.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Indicates the end of the tag processing, returning EVAL_PAGE to continue JSP processing.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches related products for a given store, group, and language, then populates ReadableProduct instances.
